summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) which extracts CipherBox cryptographic primitives, domain types, API client, FUSE filesystem, and SDK orchestration into a Cargo workspace with separate crates.
summary.outcome: Waves 1 and 2 completed successfully (plans 23-01 through 23-03). Wave 3 (plans 23-04 and 23-05) was interrupted by a usage limit mid-execution, leaving partial uncommitted work in both crates. Wave 3 was re-spawned at the end of the session but results were not yet confirmed.

repo: Project uses a GSD (get-shit-done) workflow system with wave-based parallel plan execution via subagents
Phase 23 extracts a monolithic Tauri desktop app into a Cargo workspace: crates/crypto, crates/core, crates/api-client, crates/fuse, crates/sdk
Desktop app retains 162 passing tests after crypto extraction in Wave 1; 12 new crate-level tests added in Wave 2
Crate dependency order: cipherbox-crypto → cipherbox-core → cipherbox-api-client → cipherbox-fuse / cipherbox-sdk
Cross-language test vectors (JSON files) added in 23-03 for Rust/TypeScript parity testing
workflow: GSD orchestrator runs at ~10-15% context budget; each subagent gets a fresh 200k context window
Usage limit interruption mid-wave leaves uncommitted partial work in the working tree — crate directories and some files exist but lib.rs and key modules are absent
Re-spawning agents after usage reset is the correct recovery path; agents should detect partial state and resume from where work was left off
Pre-wave dependency checks (verify key-links) are run before each wave to catch cross-plan wiring gaps early

friction: Claude usage limit hit mid-Wave 3, interrupting both 23-04 and 23-05 agents before they could commit their work
Partial uncommitted crate scaffolding (directories and some files without lib.rs) left in working tree after interruption, requiring manual inspection before re-spawning
open_items: Wave 3 (23-04 cipherbox-fuse, 23-05 cipherbox-sdk) re-spawned but not yet confirmed complete — needs spot-check of SUMMARYs and commits
Wave 4 (23-06 desktop thin shell cleanup, 23-07 CI/release-please) not yet started
